PACKMASTER-PACKMASTER_STRIKE.title: Strike
PACKMASTER-PACKMASTER_DEFEND.title: Defend
PACKMASTER-RUMMAGE.title: Rummage
PACKMASTER-RUMMAGE.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
Draw {Cards:diff()} {Cards:plural:card|cards} and reduce {Cards:plural:its|their} cost by {CostReduction} this turn.
PACKMASTER-CARDISTRY.title: Cardistry
PACKMASTER-CARDISTRY.description:
Gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold].
Put the next card you play this turn on top of your [gold]Draw Pile[/gold].
PACKMASTER-BACKPACK_SMACK.title: Backpack Smack
PACKMASTER-BACKPACK_SMACK.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage X times.
[gold]Synergy:[/gold] Apply X [gold]Weak[/gold] and [gold]Vulnerable[/gold].
PACKMASTER-BOOSTER_TUTOR.title: Booster Tutor
PACKMASTER-BOOSTER_TUTOR.description: Put {Cards:diff()} random cards from different Packs from your [gold]Draw Pile[/gold] into your [gold]Hand[/gold].
PACKMASTER-DESTINY_DRAW.title: Destiny Draw
PACKMASTER-DESTINY_DRAW.description: Choose 1 of 3 random cards from different Packs to add to your [gold]Hand[/gold]. It costs 0 this turn.
PACKMASTER-FLICK.title: Flick
PACKMASTER-FLICK.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
Discard a card. Deal {Damage:diff()} damage a number of times equal to its cost.
PACKMASTER-MAYHEM_FORM.title: Unrelenting Form
PACKMASTER-MAYHEM_FORM.description: Once per turn, when you reach 2 or fewer cards in [gold]Hand[/gold], draw {Cards} cards and gain {Energy:energyIcons()}.
PACKMASTER-RIPPED_PECS.title: Ripped Pecs
PACKMASTER-SHOWOFF.title: Showoff
PACKMASTER-SHOWOFF.description:
Gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold].
Next turn, draw {Cards} additional cards.
PACKMASTER-SIDEBOARD.title: Sideboard
PACKMASTER-SIDEBOARD.description:
Gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold].
Put a card from your [gold]Discard Pile[/gold] on top of your [gold]Draw Pile[/gold].
PACKMASTER-SIDEBOARD.selectionScreenProm: Choose a card to put on top of your Draw Pile.
PACKMASTER-SMITHING_HAMMER.title: Smithing Hammer
PACKMASTER-SMITHING_HAMMER.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage {Hits:diff()} times.
Upgrade {Cards} random cards in your [gold]Hand[/gold].
PACKMASTER-SYNERGIZE.title: Synergize
PACKMASTER-SYNERGIZE.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage to ALL enemies.
[gold]Synergy:[/gold] Gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold].
PACKMASTER-WEIGHT.title: Weight
PACKMASTER-WEIGHT.description: If this card is discarded from your [gold]Hand[/gold], [gold]Exhaust[/gold] it.
PACKMASTER-OPPRESSOR.title: Oppressor
PACKMASTER-IRON_SHIELD.title: Iron Shield
PACKMASTER-SHINE.title: Shine
PACKMASTER-SHINE.description: When you draw this card, [gold]Upgrade[/gold] {IfUpgraded:show:ALL other cards|another random card} in your [gold]Hand[/gold] for the rest of combat.
PACKMASTER-GLAIVE_THROW.title: Glaive Throw
PACKMASTER-GLAIVE_THROW.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
Draw {Cards:diff()} cards.
Discard {Cards:diff()} cards.
PACKMASTER-CRUNCH.title: Crunch
PACKMASTER-CRUNCH.description: When you draw this card, draw {Cards:diff()} cards.
PACKMASTER-LIE.title: Lie
PACKMASTER-LIE.description:
Enemy loses {StrengthLoss:diff()} [gold]Strength[/gold] this turn.
Add a [gold]Weight[/gold] to your [gold]Hand[/gold].
PACKMASTER-FRONTFLIP.title: Frontflip
PACKMASTER-FRONTFLIP.description:
Gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold].
Draw {Cards:diff()} cards, then discard any [gold]Unplayable[/gold] cards drawn.
PACKMASTER-HAMMER_THROW.title: Hammer Throw
PACKMASTER-HAMMER_THROW.description: Whenever a card is [gold]Retained[/gold], deal {HammerThrowPower:diff()} damage to ALL enemies.
PACKMASTER-FLAIL.title: Flail
PACKMASTER-FLAIL.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage twice.
Add 2 [gold]Weights[/gold] to your [gold]Hand[/gold].
PACKMASTER-WISDOM.title: Wisdom
PACKMASTER-WISDOM.description:
Gain {Energy:energyIcons()}.
Discard any number of cards in your [gold]Hand[/gold]. Draw that many cards.
